propositions: Jira Data Center cannot be tested against; Atlassian ended DC purchases and no longer issues trial licenses, and there is no official OpenAPI/Swagger spec for DC.

A vendored Dockerfile building from the addono base by digest (sha256:04326628dc4ac36b2bfc1d0f2ebe5ba3807c1ec9cf9b18307d3c2ad7222537e9) must pin the base, reproduce the atlas-run entrypoint with -DskipAllPrompts=true and -Dproduct.start.timeout=2700000, and carry load-bearing comments explaining each flag or future maintainers will delete them and introduce silent 25-minute startup failures.

The harness must run on a native amd64 architecture; emulated amd64 on arm64 hosts does not reach readiness within practical timeouts due to Cargo's 600000ms deploy ceiling and artifact download time.

Personal Access Token bearer auth (Authorization: Bearer) must be exercised against real Jira 8.17.1 by minting a token programmatically via POST /rest/pat/latest/tokens and verifying it authenticates a request, proving DC's auth mode is not assumed but proven.
Teardown must verify cleanup via direct REST endpoints (/rest/api/2/issue/{key}) polling to 404, never consulting the search index, per ADR 0037 §3 index-independence discipline.

The test suite must skip cleanly without REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1 and a running harness, define _live_jira_ready to participate in the all-skip canary, and fail the session if collected but none execute, preventing silent validation-free runs.
